intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in the Noida belt, but they do not teach the same kind of {{course}}. This page compares recorded fees, placements and admission routes from our database and official sites we opened in {{year}}.

ICRI Noida vs Shiv Nadar University is a specialisation choice, not a like-for-like ranking fight. ICRI's recorded master's is in clinical research. Shiv Nadar's listed MSc programmes here are in economics, mathematics, bioinformatics, and water science.

sections.heading: ICRI Noida vs Shiv Nadar University for MSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose ICRI Noida if you specifically want a master's in clinical research and are prepared to verify the current fee and placement report, because our placement row for that programme is from 2016.
Choose Shiv Nadar University if you want an MSc in economics, mathematics, bioinformatics or water science and governance, with a CUET PG route on our records.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For ICRI Noida we hold ₹2.50 lakh as M.Sc Clinical Research tuition for one year. That is a year figure, not a confirmed two-year total, and we do not have a programme-total row.

For Shiv Nadar University the lowest raw row is ₹25,000, but that is an admission fee, not tuition. Do not read it as the cheapest MSc fee. Recorded tuition on the same programmes is ₹1.10 lakh a year.
We could not attach a verified official programme total for either side in this pass. Recheck the current fee notice on icriindia.com and snu.edu.in before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Our only ICRI placement row is from 2016, with an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹8 lakh for M.Sc Clinical Research. That is too old to treat as a current outcome.
Shiv Nadar University has no MSc placement row in our table. If placements matter, ask both career offices for a recent, programme-specific report rather than leaning on this page's numbers.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Shiv Nadar University is listed with CUET PG on this page. ICRI has no exam mapped in our records, so follow the official clinical research admissions note for tests, interviews and eligibility.
Because the listed MSc subjects differ, a high score or a seat at one college does not automatically transfer to the other. Match the subject first, then the form.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Noida in the Delhi NCR region, so a student living in this belt can visit either campus without changing cities.
The campuses still serve different academic communities. ICRI is built around clinical research training, while Shiv Nadar is a broader private university.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick ICRI Noida only if clinical research is the degree you want, and you have confirmed the latest fee and placement letter.
Pick Shiv Nadar University if your subject is one of the MSc programmes listed here and you will apply through the current CUET PG process.
If you came to this page expecting two clinical research departments, pause. Our table does not show that overlap.

faqs.question: Do ICRI Noida and Shiv Nadar University offer the same MSc?
faqs.answer: No. Our records list ICRI's master's in clinical research, including an executive option. Shiv Nadar's listed MSc programmes here are economics, mathematics, bioinformatics, and water science and governance.

faqs.question: Is Shiv Nadar University's MSc fee only ₹25,000?
faqs.answer: No. That ₹25,000 row is an admission fee. Recorded tuition for the listed Shiv Nadar MSc programmes is ₹1.10 lakh a year. Use the official fee notice for the current total.

faqs.question: What MSc fee is on record for ICRI Noida?
faqs.answer: We hold ₹2.50 lakh as one year's tuition for M.Sc Clinical Research. It is not a confirmed two-year total. Check the official ICRI fee page before you pay.

faqs.question: Are there recent placement figures for these MSc programmes?
faqs.answer: Not in our table. ICRI's only recorded MSc placement is from 2016 (₹7 lakh average, ₹8 lakh highest). Shiv Nadar has no MSc placement row here.

faqs.question: How do I apply to these MSc programmes?
faqs.answer: Shiv Nadar University is listed with CUET PG. ICRI has no exam mapped in our records, so follow its official admissions page for the current process and eligibility.

faqs.question: Which college is better if I want to stay in Noida?
faqs.answer: Both are recorded in the Noida / Delhi NCR belt, so location alone does not decide it. Choose by the MSc subject you want, then confirm fees and placements on the official sites.
